scope: every residual `.run(` and `max_steps=1` occurrence under work/ after the twenty drivers were migrated, classified by what it actually is.  Nothing here is migrated: the point is to show that the driver layer is gone and that the remainder is not drivers.

counting.note: rows, not files: a file can contain several occurrences of either pattern.  The earlier '32 .run( and 3 max_steps=1' figures were file counts from a different scope; this table is the occurrence-level closeout.

string_or_documentation.why_allowed: the occurrence is inside a comment, docstring or string literal - most are the migrated drivers explaining the pattern they replaced

subprocess_or_library_run.why_allowed: subprocess.run and similar; not a workflow advance.  collect_status.py is the archetype: it polls solver status and prints JSON

ordinary_method_call.why_allowed: self.run, self.runner.run, self.supervisor.run, release_qN.run - methods on domain objects

internal_pipeline_or_service.why_allowed: self._pipeline.run and audit_service.run - inside the engine, not an entry point

WORKFLOW_ADVANCE_BACKUP.why_present: three .before.py copies under work/final_workflow_resume_20260911/ preserve the pre-migration source of drivers that have since been migrated
WORKFLOW_ADVANCE_BACKUP.disposition: frozen exemption, enumerated in scripts/check_no_hand_written_drivers.py's caller and in tests/test_no_hand_written_drivers.py.  Their content is redundant with the verified PRE archive; they were not renamed because that would invalidate the POST archive sealing the migrated tree

semantic_criterion.statement: workflow-advance calls (FactoryEngine.run / FactoryService(...).engine(...).run) in executable scripts = 0
semantic_criterion.verdict: MET for executable scripts.  The three backup copies are enumerated and exempted rather than migrated, and the exemption list is frozen in code so it cannot grow silently.

forbidden: a private StepRegistry subclass, or dataclasses.replace(definition, max_attempts=...)
a progress.json journal written beside a workflow advance
allowed: subprocess.run and other library run calls
ordinary method calls (self.run, self.runner.run, self.supervisor.run, release_qN.run)
the engine's internal pipeline and service calls
anything inside a comment, docstring or string literal
permanent_guard.enforcement: the detection logic is exercised against synthetic sources in CI, so it runs everywhere; the assertion against the real tree runs wherever work/ exists.  Run it before and after any new driver work on the server.

how_to_run: uv run python scripts/check_no_hand_written_drivers.py <factory>/ongoing/<project>/work --exempt <each listed backup>
